description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to properties of blocks in a board, including property schemas, property definitions, and property parsing logic for a project likely related to a task or project management system.

classes.name: PropValueResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving user IDs to user objects, used for decoding property values that reference users.

classes.name: BlockProperties
classes.description: Type alias for a map of BlockProp objects keyed by property ID.

classes.name: BlockProp
classes.description: Represents a property attached to a block, including its ID, name, value, and index.

classes.name: PropSchema
classes.description: Type alias for a map of PropDef objects keyed by property ID.

classes.name: PropDefOption
classes.description: Defines an option within a property definition, including ID, color, and value.

classes.name: PropDef
classes.description: Defines a property schema, including its ID, name, type, and options.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Resolves the display value of a property based on its type and raw value, optionally using a resolver for user lookups.

methods.name: ParseDate
methods.description: Parses a JSON string representing a date range into a human-readable date format.

methods.name: ParsePropertySchema
methods.description: Extracts property definitions from a board's fields, returning a schema map.

methods.name: getMapString
methods.description: Helper function to safely extract a string value from a map by key.

methods.name: ParseProperties
methods.description: Parses a block's fields to extract its properties, resolving values as needed.
